# Bundled M-Flasher

This directory bundles the unmodified Windows files from M-Flasher 0.6.1,
released by jvitkauskas for FM-1/SMK-37 backup, recovery, and verified flashing.

- Release: https://github.com/jvitkauskas/m-flasher/releases/tag/v0.6.1
- Download artifact: `M-Flasher-0.6.1-windows.zip`
- ZIP SHA-256: `23000BE81A34DE046B25F752F1A245B6B97DCAC958CAB6BED5AE728C9886FD91`

The app launches this binary only from its allow-listed packaged resource path.
M-Flasher is separately licensed; its included `LICENSE` is preserved here.
